retrievalProfile.description: A 90s-inspired urban group portrait featuring a desaturated, warm-toned photographic base with bold, outlined sans-serif typography and a circular emblem in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: urban group portrait with leather jackets
excludeWhen: vibrant high-saturation color palettes are requested
classical or corporate portraiture is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A candid-style group photograph of three men in leather coats and sunglasses, set against an architectural background with a sunburst-like gate detail. The image is framed by a thick border and topped with layered, outlined typography and a circular graphic badge.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography overlaps the photographic subject in the upper third
Circular badge acts as a counterweight to the main text block
Warm, desaturated photo tones contrast with the saturated red text outlines
Depth is created through the staggered positioning of the three subjects
coreInvariants: Bold sans-serif font with high-contrast outlines
Circular graphic element containing initials in the top left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line from foreground (right) to background (left), filling the central frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the leather trench coat and sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the circular badge, moves across the bold title text, then follows the diagonal line of the subjects' faces down to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subjects and architectural background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sepia and charcoal tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red used for text outlines and fills.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue-grey in the circular badge background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image base contrasted with high-value, saturated graphic overlays.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary colors except for the red accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and outline treatments.
graphicDevices: Circular badge with internal circles for letters
Thick outer border framing the photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clarity for the 90s look.
Offers a slightly more industrial, urban feel consistent with the genre.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a candid group portrait of three men in 90s urban fashion (leather coats, sunglasses) in a sepia-toned, grainy film style with an architectural gate background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, lowercase sans-serif title in the upper right with a thick red outline. Place a circular light-blue badge in the top left containing three smaller circles with initials.

verificationChecks: Is the text lowercase and outlined in red?
Is the photo desaturated with a warm, grainy texture?
Is there a circular badge in the top left corner?
Are the subjects wearing leather jackets and sunglasses?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or existing logos
Ensure the background gate pattern is generic and not a direct copy
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subjects' faces entirely
Verify the 'SFP' style badge is present and distinct
Ensure the border framing is even on all sides
Confirm the red outline is vibrant against the muted background
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Sepia Grain + Outlined Lowercase Sans-Serif + Corner Badge
